title: The Real Reason You Mimic People You Admire
hook: You copy other people's posture, without realising it.

narration.text: You unconsciously copy the posture and gestures of people you are talking to.
This mirroring effect helps you to build rapport with them.
It shows empathy and creates a sense of connection.
Your brain does this automatically, a social shortcut to bonding.
Watch yourself next time you are in a conversation.
Notice if you lean in when they do, or cross your arms.
Try it right now, comment if it worked on you, like this if it surprised you, and subscribe to understand your mind.

description: Have you ever noticed yourself adopting the same posture as someone you're talking to? This subtle mirroring is a fascinating social phenomenon that happens without you even realising it, building connection and empathy. It is an unconscious act that helps foster rapport and understanding between people.
topic: Why you tend to copy the posture and gestures of someone you are talking to. Watch yourself and others in your next conversation.
